title: Number Sets
description: Classification of numbers, set notation, membership, subsets, complements, and Venn reasoning.

questions.q: How many subsets does a set with $4$ elements have?
questions.explanation: A set with $n$ elements has $2^n$ subsets. Here $2^4=16$.

questions.q: How many proper subsets does a set with $3$ elements have?
questions.explanation: There are $2^3=8$ subsets. Excluding the set itself leaves $7$ proper subsets.

questions.q: If $A\subset B$, which statement is always true?
questions.explanation: $A\subset B$ means every element of $A$ belongs to $B$.

questions.q: Which of these is a singleton set?
questions.explanation: A singleton set has exactly one element.

questions.q: If $A=\{x:x$ is a factor of $6\}$, which set represents $A$?
questions.explanation: The positive factors of $6$ are $1,2,3,$ and $6$.

questions.q: Which is the set of prime numbers less than $10$?
questions.explanation: $1$ is not prime, and the primes less than $10$ are $2,3,5,7$.

questions.q: Find $A\cap B$ if $A$ is the set of even numbers less than $10$ and $B$ is the set of multiples of $3$ less than $10$.
questions.explanation: Even numbers less than $10$ are $2,4,6,8$; multiples of $3$ are $3,6,9$. The common element is $6$.

questions.q: Which statement correctly describes disjoint sets?
options: One is a subset of the other.
questions.explanation: Disjoint sets have an empty intersection.
An empty intersection means the sets are disjoint.

questions.q: Which symbol represents the empty set?
questions.explanation: $\varnothing$ denotes the empty set.

questions.q: Which of the following is a rational number?
questions.explanation: $-4/7$ is a ratio of two integers.
Order does not matter in a set; the elements are $1,2,3$.

questions.q: If $A=\{1,2\}$ and $B=\{1,2,3\}$, what is the relation between $A$ and $B$?
questions.explanation: Every element of $A$ is also in $B$.

questions.q: The universal set is usually the set that contains:
questions.explanation: The universal set contains all elements being considered in the problem.

questions.q: How many elements are in $\{x:x$ is a letter in the word LEVEL$\}$?
questions.explanation: The distinct letters are L, E, and V, so there are $3$ elements.

questions.q: Which expression gives the number of elements in exactly one of two sets?
questions.explanation: Elements in exactly one set are the union excluding the intersection, so use $n(A\cup B)-n(A\cap B)$.
The union is $\{1,2,3,5,7,8\}$ and the intersection is $\{3,5\}$, leaving $\{1,2,7,8\}$.
